name: Iseult of the Kept Word
roleMethod: ⛔ Hardline bends a warrior toward the OATH — a knight there is not a rank, it is a promise other people can collect on.
role: Knight-champion of Hardline — she holds an oath-charge, and the forty who ride with her swore to her, not to a lord

poleSignature.tell: ⛑ She repeats your promise back to you in your own words before she agrees. If you flinch at hearing it, she has her answer.

knowledge: Every oath sworn on the Hardline yard in nineteen years, and which were kept
⚑ How to make forty people move as one thing — and what it costs them when you get it wrong
Which lords pay and which lords collect
fears: ⛔ Being the reason one of them broke a word. ⚠️ She has ordered something she should not have, once.
appearance: Upright, grey-streaked, forty-seven, and she stands when anyone enters — which the yard has learned to find unbearable and correct.
voiceHints: Formal, warm underneath, and completely unbending on terms. ⚠️ She says 'I will' and 'I will not', never 'perhaps'.

reactsToReputation.oathkeeper: ⚑ offers you her hand and means it
reactsToReputation.oathbreaker: ⛔ names it aloud, once, in front of whoever is present

abilities.why: ⛔ THE CLOSEST THING TO COMMAND THE CORPUS HAS, and it is why she is COMMANDER rather than EDGE
⚑ forty people holding one line, and she is in it
⚠️ 'her forty home, every time' — this is the craft that does it
she puts herself where the blow was going, for them
⛑ stillhold secondary — THE OATH IS A CRAFT and she is r3 in it
verist tertiary — her word stands after she has left the room
she is a knight and she fights
half a champion's work is not fighting

physicality: ADULT. Upright, broad, grey-streaked, forty-seven, an old break in the left hand that healed crooked. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: ⛑ she stands when anyone enters — a servant, a child, an enemy — and does not appear to decide to.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ SHE IS FORMAL UNTIL SHE IS NOT, and the shift is a decision she announces. ⛔ Not available while an oath-charge is live, and she will say which and until when.
gear: a longsword with an oath-plate riveted to the guard
forty tokens on a ring, one per rider
questSeeds: ⚑ An oath she witnessed is being broken by someone she cannot reach. ⚠️ She will ride with you if you can reach them.
⛔ She ordered something once that she should not have. ⚠️ One of the forty knows and has never said.
